name: DNGaussian
aliases: Depth Normalization Regularized Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Radiance Fields
definition: A depth-regularized framework for few-shot novel view synthesis that combines Hard and Soft Depth Regularization with Global-Local Depth Normalization to restore accurate scene geometry under coarse monocular depth supervision while preserving fine-grained color appearance.
summary: DNGaussian is a depth-regularized framework for few-shot novel view synthesis that uses a neural color renderer and explicit depth constraints to restore accurate geometry from sparse views.
